text_block_list.text:
The day of Маяно Топ Ган's debut has
arrived!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look at me, Trainer! I'm not wearing a
tracksuit
today!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Bingo! You get a gold star and an A++
from me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You know what that means, right? You
gotta
keep your eyes on me! Got it?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how brightly I can
sparkle in the
Twinkle Series! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
